plots.title: Matt Seizes the Crown
plots.text: Matt has overturned Nikhil's one-point lead to go 17 clear on 774 to 757, with Ravin third 39 points off the top. The crown has now changed hands 4 times this season, and Matt is top for the first time in this run.
plots.next: Nikhil could fight back, but Ravin is 39 points adrift and needs a big swing.
plots.question: Who can hold the crown?

plots.title: Sunny Snatches Gold
plots.text: Sunny has taken the last Gold spot from Deepak, who dropped out this week, leaving a 2-point gap between them. Sunny has spent just 1 of the last 5 weeks in the zone, while Deepak has spent 4.
plots.next: Deepak could fight back into the last Gold spot if Sunny's form dips.
plots.question: Who holds the last Gold spot?

plots.title: Alia's Lowest Ebb
plots.text: Alia scored 29 this week, her lowest figure of the run, extending her streak below the league average to 7 weeks in a row. The slump is deepening rather than easing.
plots.next: Alia could snap out of it soon, or the streak could stretch further still.
plots.question: Can Alia snap out of it?

plots.title: Vanessa's Lead Narrows
plots.text: Vanessa still leads Ravi Mahtani, but her advantage has shrunk from 5 points to 3 this week. The pair have swapped places 7 times this season, so the lead has never been secure.
plots.next: Ravi Mahtani could draw level if he keeps gaining on Vanessa.
plots.question: Vanessa v Ravi Mahtani: who blinks first?

plots.title: Naresh Keeps Climbing
plots.text: Naresh has risen from 25th in GW7 to 14th now, climbing in every week except GW10, when he held at 18. His jump to 14th this week was the biggest of his run.
plots.next: If he keeps climbing, Naresh could push into the top 10 before the season ends.
plots.question: How far can Naresh's climb go?

piece.headline: MATT TAKES THE CROWN AS HAALAND BLANKS
piece.big_picture: Nikhil had been alone at the top for 1 week in a row (from GW10). Matt takes top spot from Nikhil, 17 points clear. 22 of 26 managers captained Haaland. He scored 2, so 4 each with the armband (6 for the 1 on Triple Captain).
piece.one_to_watch: Rajiv and Lakshay are level on the Tin Pot line, with nothing between them. One good week could split them. One more bench blunder could sink either.

winners.verdict: Bench Boost brought 23 points off the bench. Sunny also backed Belloumi alone and he delivered. Skill and nerve, with a touch of luck.

winners.verdict: 4 straight weeks above the league average. No fireworks, just a side that kept ticking until the crown came free.

piece.headline: Matt takes the throne as Haaland lets Nikhil down
piece.standfirst: Matt goes top for the first time, Nikhil drops to 2nd, and Sunny's Bench Boost tears up the script.
piece.big_picture: Matt is top alone for the first time, 17 clear. A month ago he was 8th at his lowest. 4 weeks above average did it, not a lucky week. Nikhil's single week on top ended with the armband blank that 22 managers shared. Sunny's Bench Boost is the other headline, a jump into the Gold spots.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Ravi Mahtani played a Wildcard, then left 26 points sitting on the bench. Fresh squad, wrong XI. The Wildcard did its job. The Sunday team sheet did not.
piece.one_to_watch: Rajiv and Lakshay are level at the Tin Pot line. Rajiv has outscored Lakshay more often this season. If Lakshay's bench behaves, that could flip.

column.headline: Haaland blanks again as Sunny's Bench Boost steals the week
column.text: Matt's Lammo's Lads still sit top after collecting 52, with Nikhil 17 points back at Umm Suqeim FC. Haaland's armband returned just 2 points, which means 4 for each of his 22 captains, and that blank cost most of the league. Sunny's Bench Boost hauled 67 to climb from 8th to 4th, the standout week so far. Ravin, Deepak and Chandru are all still within touching distance, so the chase is far from over.

gamble:3506595:10.title: The Barry Gamble
gamble:3506595:10.text: Hishaan was the only manager to captain Barry, who scored 32 points and paid off the gamble. Hishaan climbed from 21st to 13th while 15 managers backed Haaland.

title.title: One Point Separates Them
title.text: Nikhil's lead collapsed from 24 to 1 this week, leaving Matt just one point behind on 722 to Nikhil's 723. Deepak sits 15 points off the top, and the crown has changed hands 3 times this season.
title.next: If Matt completes the overtake, Nikhil could be chasing the crown back from a single point.

title.title: Matt Seizes the Crown
title.text: Matt has overturned Nikhil's one-point lead to go 17 clear on 774 to 757, with Ravin third 39 points off the top. The crown has now changed hands 4 times this season, and Matt is top for the first time in this run.
title.next: Nikhil could fight back, but Ravin is 39 points adrift and needs a big swing.

rivalry:4922092-5682768.title: Vanessa Edges Ahead
rivalry:4922092-5682768.text: Vanessa has flipped the rivalry, moving 5 points clear of Ravi Mahtani after he led by 7 in GW9. The pair have swapped places 7 times this season, so neither has ever held a clear grip.
rivalry:4922092-5682768.next: Ravi Mahtani could reclaim the edge, or Vanessa could pull further away and end the back-and-forth.

rivalry:4922092-5682768.title: Vanessa's Lead Narrows
rivalry:4922092-5682768.text: Vanessa still leads Ravi Mahtani, but her advantage has shrunk from 5 points to 3 this week. The pair have swapped places 7 times this season, so the lead has never been secure.
rivalry:4922092-5682768.next: Ravi Mahtani could draw level if he keeps gaining on Vanessa.

gold.title: The Gold Spot Cliffhanger
gold.text: Matt is the last manager in the 4 Gold spots, with Chandru first out just 3 points behind. Matt has spent only one of the last 5 weeks in the zone, while Chandru has spent 2.

gold.title: Sunny Snatches Gold
gold.text: Sunny has taken the last Gold spot from Deepak, who dropped out this week, leaving a 2-point gap between them. Sunny has spent just 1 of the last 5 weeks in the zone, while Deepak has spent 4.
gold.next: Deepak could fight back into the last Gold spot if Sunny's form dips.

chase:4487775.title: Prem Cuts Rohan's Lead
chase:4487775.text: Prem has closed Rohan's lead from 34 points in GW7 to just 5 in GW10. The gap has shrunk every week since the chase began.
chase:4487775.next: If Prem keeps this pace, Rohan could be caught before the season ends.

chase:3029346.title: Matt's chase tightens
chase:3029346.text: Matt has cut Nikhil's 37-point lead from GW7 to just one point now. The gap has shrunk every week, and the next gameweek could settle it either way.

slump:6051923.title: Alia's Long Struggle
slump:6051923.text: Alia has now finished below the league average for 6 weeks in a row. Her 50 points this week is an improvement on 42 in GW9, but she is still stuck in the slump.
slump:6051923.next: If Alia builds on this week's 50, the 6-week run of underperformance could finally end.

slump:6051923.title: Alia's Lowest Ebb
slump:6051923.text: Alia scored 29 this week, her lowest figure of the run, extending her streak below the league average to 7 weeks in a row. The slump is deepening rather than easing.
slump:6051923.next: Alia could snap out of it soon, or the streak could stretch further still.

award:captain:3344797.title: Rohan's Captaincy Crown
award:captain:3344797.text: Rohan has won Captain of the Week 5 times this season, setting the bar for everyone else. The rest of the league is still chasing that record.
award:captain:3344797.next: Could someone else finally break Rohan's grip on the captaincy award?

rise:2934546.title: Naresh Keeps Climbing
rise:2934546.text: Naresh has risen from 25th in GW7 to 14th now, climbing in every week except GW10, when he held at 18. His jump to 14th this week was the biggest of his run.
rise:2934546.next: If he keeps climbing, Naresh could push into the top 10 before the season ends.
